column1: # The UAT gate's scenario catalogue, from docs/claude-code-parallel-build-plan.md
# section 4h. Tab-separated: id, tiers (comma separated, the first decides the
# test-function prefix: smoke -> TestSmoke, core -> TestCore, resilience ->
# scenario, and the brief that implements it. uatreport reads this file to
# select tests and to enforce the no silent green rule; TestCatalogueMatchesPlan
# keeps it in step with the plan's table. I.* stands for every I.name.method id.

column3: Create a tenant (POST /v1/tenants, 202), poll status until active
Validation: a missing name is refused
Status shows last_error or warning when set
Delete: offboarding then offboarded; 409 provisioning_in_progress while provisioning
After offboarding the tenant's keys, sprouts and bus account are cut off
Two tenants stay separate for tenants, keys, sprouts, recipes and job logs
Mint an enrolment key with expiry and max_uses
A key at max_uses is refused for the next enrolment
A revoked key is refused; sprouts already enrolled stay
Minting is rate limited (1 per second, burst 5)
Install the published package, enrol through Envoy, sprout connected under its own tenant
The same sproutid in both tenants resolves to different machines
Asset link: new 201, repeat 200, collision 409 asset_link_conflict
Lookup by asset_ids; another tenant's ids come back unresolved without saying why
A sprout with no box key is refused (sprout_reenroll_required); nothing is sent in plaintext
Uninstall and reinstall on the same host re-enrols cleanly
cmd.run succeeds on every sprout, all three OS
A non zero exit gives command_failed with the exit code
timeout_seconds is honoured
Shell syntax is rejected; args, cwd and run_as work
An unknown asset id comes back unresolved
A stopped sprout gives sprout_unreachable
A batch over several sprouts reports per item results
The per tenant rate limit applies
Recipe upload, list, fetch, delete through the API
Read and write roles are enforced (a read only user cannot write)
Recipes are tenant scoped
Cook a recipe by name on a sprout
Cook in test mode reports pending changes, then none after a real run
Recipes with properties, templates and OS conditions over a mixed OS batch
Ingredient conformance: one case per registered ingredient method
Each sprout survives a reboot, reconnects and runs a job
Restarting farmer: sprouts stay connected or reconnect, jobs run
Restarting farmerbus and Envoy: sprouts reconnect
Package upgrade from the previous release to this one keeps /etc/imas/sprout and the sproutid
One self update cycle with the dispatch flags on (opt in, UAT only)
No token, expired token, wrong audience, read only token on a write route: refused as documented
A sprout presenting no gateway JWT is refused at Envoy
A sprout cannot open a connection to core
Cross tenant access by a tenant admin token is denied everywhere
Sealing: plaintext cmd.run and cook are refused by a sprout
